project.status_summary: The bounded geometry and presentation corrections are applied. The drawing now uses clean closed wall footprints, 1419-led existing-condition layers, readable annotation, a controlled black/gray plot hierarchy, an aligned plan title, and a PDF with zero SHX comments or annotations. AutoCAD Architecture 2026 AUDIT found zero errors.

project.production_status: The 0.5-hour consolidated correction reserve is consumed and the contracted 8.0-hour effort limit is reached. The package remains review-ready pending BDPC acceptance.

payment.request_text: Payment is requested for the authorized Dunn Residence one-sheet CAD engagement. Stripe hosts and secures the checkout.

standards.rule: A101 — Existing Main Level As-Built Floor Plan
24 × 36 landscape; 1/4 inch = 1 foot locked viewport; layout plotted 1:1
Residential dimensions display no finer than 1/2 inch unless directed otherwise
Use 3.5-inch baseline unless evidence supports another assembly
Do not guess; disclose field verification where appropriate
Omit unless absolute orientation is verified
Use BDPC-supplied CTB/STB, fonts, title-block, copyright, and sheet-format direction when received
Point-cloud evidence and published controls govern Dunn geometry; reference DWGs govern standards only
